Hey everyone,t since yall are just as into WoT as I am, there is a fan-made game that has been around for a good while called The Game of Stones.

The new age (total restart) will launch at 10 PM CST on March 3rd (4AM on March 4th GMT).




Official Site address: gos.talij.com




It is hard to explain the game, but its essentially an RPG with the goal is to join/create a clan, take over and develop cities from the books, battle hordes and other players, all leading to the Last Battle where you must defend those cities from destruction. I promise if you give it a chance , you wont be disappointed.




I've been using the name Justin alSeen in the game, shoot me a message if you have any questions. There will be a training clan called Training Clan or something equally obvious for new members to learn the ropes and get help joining main clans or starting there own. Theres a good many people playing, but not too many to make it feel crowded. There were brand new players last age who kicked old players butts so dont feel like youll be at a disadvantage lol Hope to see yall there!
